services.value: Full service environmental analytical testing laboratory providing testing for drinking water (including lead & copper, PFAS/PFCs, UCMR5, low level mercury, methamphetamine cleanup verification, and other contaminants), wastewater/soil/compost, hazardous waste, pesticide & herbicide analysis, and food pathogen and food microbiology testing. Also offers compliance sampling such as ANSI/AAMI ST108 for water for the processing of medical devices.
